subject: Onboarding: ProcurePlus billing model & PO requirement
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@procureplus.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick onboarding question — PO requirement

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we loved how Redwood handles model rollouts. Procurement at ProcurePlus is ready to move forward, but our finance team prefers vendor relationships without a per-purchase PO when possible. They use consolidated monthly invoices and net-30 payment.

Before we start the formal onboarding, can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a vendor setup where ProcurePlus is invoiced monthly without issuing a separate PO per purchase? If you need a signed contract or a one-time onboarding PO instead, let us know what information you need and we can send your onboarding form and a sample invoice.

I've attached our onboarding form and sample invoice to speed things up.

Best,
Sam Reynolds
Head of Finance Operations
ProcurePlus
Attachments: procureplus_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf), procureplus_invoice_sample.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@procureplus.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick onboarding question — PO requirement

Hi Sam — great to hear. Short answer: we can be flexible but need procurement & finance to align on one of a few supported patterns.

Options we typically accept:
- Standard PO per order (default, preferred for ledgering).
- Account-level PO (single PO referencing a vendor code and month) + monthly invoices (works for many SaaS customers).
- Contract + self-billing/merchant invoice agreement (requires Finance sign-off).

To evaluate, can you confirm: 1) whether ProcurePlus will accept an "account-level PO" that references a vendor code and month, and 2) approximate annual spend so I can check whether this triggers any internal thresholds that require a formal PO per transaction?

I've looped in Laura (Procurement) and Marissa (Finance operations) to weigh in on thresholds and the contract path. If you prefer, we can draft a short SOW and a one-time onboarding PO just to get you started and move you to monthly invoicing thereafter.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, sam.reynolds@procureplus.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick onboarding question — PO requirement

Thanks Tessa/Sam — quick procurement note: we can make an exception for account-level PO + monthly invoice for SaaS vendors on a case-by-case basis. Key requirements:
- Signed MSA or short SOW referencing billing cadence
- Vendor bank / W9 (or equivalent) on file
- A single account-level PO must be raised and kept active for the billing period (e.g., PO #2026-PP-1001 for Oct–Dec).

Thresholds: any vendor with anticipated annual spend > $120k requires a quarterly PO review and approval from VP Finance. Below that, the procurement team can approve the account-level PO without escalations.

If ProcurePlus is comfortable with an account-level PO, we can accept the onboarding form and create the PO on our side. Otherwise, we can approve a one-time onboarding PO to get the pilot started and convert to monthly invoices later.

Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@procureplus.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: onboarding@procureplus.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick onboarding question — PO requirement

Laura/Tessa — thanks for the clarity. ProcurePlus can do the account-level PO approach. We expect first-year spend to be ~$45k for the pilot, so we're well below the 120k threshold.

Next steps from our side:
- I attached a completed onboarding form and a draft vendor payment profile.
- Please generate the account-level PO number you prefer and send any contract/SOW you want signed.
- We can accept monthly invoices net-30 referencing that PO number.

I'll also copy our legal team if you want to push a short SOW to speed signature.

Sam

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: sam.reynolds@procureplus.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick onboarding question — PO requirement

Hi all — looped in Finance ops. We reviewed the onboarding form and the sample invoice. Given the ~$45k projection, Procurement can approve an account-level PO for the pilot.

Action items:
- Procurement (Laura) to create PO #2026-PP-1001 covering Oct–Dec pilot.
- Legal (cc to be added if needed) — Tessa, please share the one-page SOW you mentioned; we prefer a short SOW that references monthly billing and net-30.
- Sam — we need procuresplus_contract_draft.docx signed (I attached a template with minimal edits). Once contract is signed and vendor bank/W9 are on file, we'll enable monthly invoicing.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
